landing.heroOutcome: Publish on YouTube without building a studio
landing.heroSupport: Script, voice, edit, human review, and publishing — one workflow for your channel.
landing.problemTitle: Running a channel shouldn’t need a full crew
landing.problemLead: Script, voice, edit, and YouTube publishing eat weeks. Reelpath folds that work into one flow you control.
landing.problemPain1: Sourcing scripts and voiceovers from separate vendors slows every drop.
landing.problemPain2: Hand-editing long-form and Shorts doubles the work per topic.
landing.problemPain3: Publishing without a clear review gate risks tone, rights, and channel quality.
landing.capabilitiesCopy: From idea to YouTube video, with your brand and editorial judgment at every step.
landing.capScriptDesc: Ideas, scripts, and voice matched to each channel’s tone and audience.
landing.capMediaDesc: Scenes, captions, and renders ready to review — long-form and vertical.
landing.capReviewDesc: Approve or reject before publishing. Nothing goes live without you.
landing.capPublishDesc: Publish now or schedule. Your OAuth account, your channel.
landing.audienceEduDesc: History, science, curiosities: documentary pace with editorial control.
landing.audienceSoloDesc: Publish consistently without building a studio or over-hiring.
landing.audienceStudioDesc: Multiple channels, volume, and review workflows for the team.
landing.proofCopy: «{channelName}» is a live channel produced with Reelpath: from topic to YouTube video, with review before publish.
landing.stepProductionDesc: Pick a topic or let the system suggest one. Script, voice, visuals, and editing in a single flow.
landing.stepReviewDesc: Watch each video and its Shorts before publishing. You decide what goes live.
landing.stepPublishDesc: Publish to YouTube instantly or schedule a date. Long-form and vertical Shorts.
landing.pricingCopy: Start with a 14-day free trial. When you're ready, pick the monthly plan that fits your publishing pace.
landing.pricingAside: Monthly plans cover production, review, and YouTube publishing.
landing.faqAiA: YouTube doesn't ban AI, but it requires transparency when content is clearly synthetic. Reelpath includes human review before publishing: you approve each video and publish to your own connected account.
landing.faqControlQ: Do I lose control of my channel?
landing.faqControlA: No. You connect your YouTube account via OAuth and Reelpath only publishes what you approve. You can disconnect the integration at any time.
landing.faqEducationalQ: Does it work for educational channels like history documentaries?
landing.faqEducationalA: Yes. Channels like «{channelName}» use Reelpath to produce scripts, voice, and visuals with a documentary tone, review each piece, and publish long-form and Shorts on YouTube.
landing.faqCopyrightA: You define the niche, blocked topics, and editorial guidelines per channel. Reelpath generates content under your settings; the final review is yours before publishing.
landing.finalCtaCopy: Create your account, connect YouTube, and generate your first video with human review before publishing.
landing.demoChannelDesc: A live educational channel: scripts, voice, visuals, and publishing produced with Reelpath — with human review before going live.
landing.demoFeature2: Voice and visuals reviewed before publish
landing.demoFeature3: Long-form and Shorts in one flow
landing.planCreatorDesc: For creators with a weekly cadence.

privacy.metaDescription: Reelpath privacy policy — AI video creation and publishing platform.
privacy.s1P1: The data controller for personal data associated with the Reelpath platform is its operator. Reelpath is a SaaS application for AI-assisted video production and publishing.
privacy.s2P1: This policy describes how Reelpath handles information in relation to: (a) the Reelpath website and dashboard; (b) OAuth integration with YouTube; and (c) the content production workflow managed by Reelpath users.
privacy.s2P2: Reelpath does not govern data processing by Google/YouTube or other platforms when you interact with them directly.
privacy.s3Li1: Reelpath account: name, email address, and sign-in credentials (password stored securely, never in plain text).
privacy.s3Li2: Connected account: YouTube OAuth tokens required to publish videos and Shorts on the user account. Reelpath does not store YouTube passwords.
privacy.s3Li3: Production content: ideas, scripts, metadata, and video files generated in Reelpath.
privacy.s3Li4: Technical data: server logs, pipeline identifiers, and publication status.
privacy.s3Li5: Communications: messages sent to Reelpath contact by email.
privacy.s3P1: Reelpath does not sell personal data or use it for third-party behavioral advertising.
privacy.s4Li1: Provide video creation, review, and publishing services.
privacy.s4Li2: Authenticate users and maintain secure sessions in Reelpath.
privacy.s4Li3: Connect and publish to the YouTube account authorized by the user.
privacy.s4Li4: Maintain security, support, and technical operation of Reelpath.
privacy.s4P1: Legal bases include contract performance, consent when connecting third-party accounts, and legitimate interest in service security.
privacy.s5Title: 5. Use of the YouTube / Google API
privacy.s5P1: Reelpath uses the YouTube Data API to upload long videos and Shorts and manage metadata on the connected account. Use is subject to the
privacy.s5Link: Google API Services User Data Policy
privacy.s5Li1: Only the authorized owner connects their channel via OAuth in Reelpath.
privacy.s5Li2: Requested permissions are limited to those needed to upload and manage publications.
privacy.s5Li3: You can revoke access at any time from Google or by disconnecting in Reelpath.
privacy.s6Intro: Reelpath may share data with providers necessary for the service:
privacy.s6Li1: Google / YouTube — hosting and publishing of videos and Shorts
privacy.s6Li2: AI and voice providers (e.g. OpenAI, ElevenLabs) — content generation per configuration
privacy.s6Li3: Infrastructure providers — hosting, databases, and storage
privacy.s7Li1: OAuth tokens: while the integration remains active in Reelpath or until revoked.
privacy.s7Li2: Production content: as long as necessary for the service or until deletion is requested.
privacy.s7Li3: Technical logs: typically up to 90 days, unless a longer legal obligation applies.
privacy.s8P1: Reelpath applies reasonable technical and organizational measures: encrypted communications (HTTPS), access control, secure credential storage, and human review before publishing to YouTube.
privacy.s9P1: You may exercise access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability by writing to {email}. You may also lodge a complaint with the
privacy.s10P1: Reelpath is intended for users aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
privacy.s11P1: Reelpath uses strictly necessary technical cookies for session and dashboard operation. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.
privacy.s12P1: Reelpath may update this policy. We will publish the revised version at this URL with the «Last updated» date.

terms.metaDescription: Reelpath terms of service — AI video creation and publishing platform.

terms.s2P1: Reelpath is a SaaS platform for AI-assisted video creation and publishing. Reelpath lets creators generate content and publish it on their own YouTube account — long videos and vertical Shorts.
terms.s3Li1: AI-assisted generation of scripts, voice, images, and videos.
terms.s3Li2: Review and approval dashboard before publishing.
terms.s3Li3: OAuth integration with YouTube for publishing on the user account.
terms.s3Li4: Multi-channel and multi-organization management for production teams.
terms.s4Intro: To use Reelpath you declare that:
terms.s4Li1: You are at least 18 years old or have verifiable parental authorization.
terms.s4Li2: You have legal capacity to accept these terms.
terms.s4Li3: You own or are authorized to manage the YouTube account you connect in Reelpath.
terms.s4Li4: You provide truthful information when registering in Reelpath.
terms.s5Intro: You agree to use Reelpath lawfully. The following is prohibited:
terms.s5Li1: Publishing illegal, defamatory, violent, discriminatory content or content that infringes third-party rights.
terms.s5Li2: Violating YouTube terms and policies or any integrated platform.
terms.s5Li3: Unauthorized access to systems, APIs, or data beyond the granted OAuth scope.
terms.s5Li4: Using Reelpath for spam, impersonation, or unauthorized commercial exploitation.
terms.s6P1: Content you generate or publish through Reelpath is your responsibility. Reelpath does not guarantee the accuracy of all AI-generated content. You must review material before publishing.
terms.s6P2: YouTube, Google, and other mentioned brands belong to their owners. Reelpath is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Google except where expressly stated.
terms.s7P1: By connecting accounts in Reelpath, you authorize the platform to perform publication actions you initiate. Use of third-party APIs is also subject to their own terms and policies.
terms.s8P1: Use of the YouTube Data API from Reelpath implies acceptance of the
terms.s8Li1: OAuth permissions are used only for authorized publishing functions.
terms.s8Li2: You can disconnect Reelpath from Google or from the Reelpath dashboard at any time.
terms.s9P1: Reelpath uses artificial intelligence tools under human supervision. We do not guarantee absolute accuracy of generated content. The user is responsible for reviewing and approving material before publishing.
terms.s10P1: Reelpath is provided «as is» and «as available». We may modify, suspend, or discontinue features for maintenance, legal requirements, or third-party API changes.
terms.s10P2: We may update these terms. Continued use of Reelpath after changes are published implies acceptance.

terms.s12P1: Reelpath may suspend or terminate access if you breach these terms, if required by law, or if an external provider revokes API access. You may stop using Reelpath and revoke OAuth permissions at any time.

settingsExt.publicationDesc: YouTube is linked per channel, each with its own account.
settingsExt.publicationManage: Manage YouTube integration from each channel.
settingsExt.apikeysDesc: Choose AI and voice providers for your organization. Keys come from Atlas env inject or ops PlatformSecret fallback. Changes apply to new generations.
settingsExt.apikeysPlatformHint: OpenAI, DeepSeek, and ElevenLabs are managed by the platform admin (sidebar Admin → Infra). Status only here; no BYOK paste.
settingsExt.apikeysAdminOnly: Only administrators can manage generation settings and API keys.
settingsExt.apikeysLlmHint: DeepSeek is usually much cheaper. Auto picks DeepSeek when a key is available.
settingsExt.apikeysTtsHint: Edge is free. ElevenLabs and OpenAI TTS bill per minute.
settingsExt.apikeysVoiceHint: Voice applies to the selected TTS provider. Empty = server default.
settingsExt.apikeysVoiceHintAuto: Auto prefers Edge (free) first. This list is Edge voices; switch provider to see ElevenLabs or OpenAI.
settingsExt.apikeysImagesHint: Off = stock/Pexels or procedural (much cheaper). On uses OpenAI credits per scene.
settingsExt.apikeysScenesHint: Empty = server default ({default}). Fewer scenes = less TTS and images. Channels can override this.
settingsExt.apikeysMaxAiHint: Empty = server default ({default}). 0 = unlimited. Only applies when AI images are enabled.
settingsExt.apikeysQualityHint: Medium is usually the best cost/quality tradeoff. High costs much more.
settingsExt.apikeysByokHint: Optional. Fields stay empty on purpose (keys are never shown). If empty, platform secrets are used. Only fill to override with org BYOK.
settingsExt.apikeysPlatformKeysNote: OpenAI, DeepSeek, and ElevenLabs keys come from Atlas (envFrom) or Admin → Secrets (fallback). No paste here.
settingsExt.devHint: If the panel cannot connect, run npm run dev:clean in the project.
